conversation_pain_points: bot did not simplify language when asked
bot did not answer the user's request

main_topics.reason: User opened asking if nothing can be done and later said she just wanted to know if she will feel like this forever.
Much of the conversation covered medications and exercise the bot listed, and user asked how to get them.
User described hurting all over, worst in the mornings in hands, shoulders and hips.
User asked in one turn whether tiredness after 9 hours of sleep is part of fibro.
User briefly checked whether the exercise term meant walking.
User said the doctor just named the diagnosis and sent her home, and asked how to get medications.
User asked how to obtain medications and the bot suggested asking for a specialist referral; user did not pursue it further.
User repeatedly said she was confused and her head was spinning.

output.summary: A 71-year-old user told by her doctor that nothing much can be done for her fibromyalgia asked whether that is true and whether she will feel this way forever. The bot repeatedly used technical terms such as SNRI, central sensitization and rule out comorbidities despite her asking for plain language three times. She ended confused and tired, with only a suggestion to ask her doctor about medication and a specialist referral.
